steps: Select the next dependency-ready phase from the master directive and do not open uncontrolled parallel edits.
Write a failing test first for that phase before changing implementation code.
Implement the smallest correct change that makes the new test pass.
Record evidence for the revision, commands, results, failures, and unresolved gates.
Integrate on the existing branch main with fast-forward publication only.
Verify the remote head before an authorized push.
When push access is absent, return a truthful blocked report and do not invent a publication.
Treat a host gate pass with a pending physical gate as software-verified only.
Preserve a concurrent remote commit; do not reset or overwrite collaborator work.
Do not treat local build success as completion of every phase.
completionRule: host and physical gates are separate; local build is not phase completion
